rationale: Per-bank audited financial statement archive — the core A1 disclosure repository for Montenegro.
Standardised per-bank balance sheet/P&L templates; recurring structured data, easy to normalise.
Licensed-bank register: mine once for the full actor seed list, refresh occasionally rather than monitor.
Payment institutions register — seed list of non-bank PSPs; payments actors are in scope equally.
E-money institution register; one-off mine for the EMI/fintech population.
Payment systems register maps infrastructure operators; static list, mine once.
Hub index over the individual registers already captured; no standalone signal.
Withdrawn-authorisation list is a recurring negative signal on market exits and enforcement.
RTGS/DNS/IPS transaction volumes — the core recurring payments time series for ME.
Cards/POS/ATM and e-money statistics; highest-value demand-side series, URL path to re-verify.
Statistics-department payment turnover series on a predictable release calendar.
Monthly MFI aggregate balance sheet, loans/deposits/rates — backbone banking-market sizing data.
Financial soundness indicators (CAR, NPL, ROA/ROE) published recurrently by the regulator.
Financial-stability report and indicator hub; recurring narrative plus data on banks and payments.
English edition of the annual stability report — recurring, citable, partly redundant with the ME page.
CBCG annual operations report with sector aggregates; url_verification failed is soft, browser pass to confirm.
Quarterly/annual macro reports with a banking-sector chapter; highest-frequency narrative source.
Publications master index incl. Governor's monthly report — durable discovery root.
Press-release feed carrying licence, regulation and SEPA/IPS milestones first.
Regulator-hosted per-bank payment tariff sheets — rare comparable pricing dataset; recheck live URL.
Non-bank credit provider registers on an /images/ path of uncertain validity; adjacent scope, re-check later.
Central register of corporate transaction accounts and blocked entities; indirect market-share and risk signal.
Static service description of the credit register; context only, record-level data restricted.
Secondary-legislation repository defining the Pillar 3 / payment reporting disclosure obligations.
FOI index enumerating all CBCG-held registers; mine once for hidden datasets, also the FOI entry point.
Recognised ECAI list — thin, one-off pointer to third-party rating sources.
Supervision section root over pages already captured individually; useful crawl fallback, not standalone.
IR/reports page of the market-leading bank; primary A1 disclosure source, verify liveness and reuse terms.
